title: Waqt
desc: An earthquake tears a businessman's family apart. Years later, they reunite in a courtroom trial where the father meets his sons under unprecedented circumstances.

title: Bawarchi
desc: Shivnath is the head of the Sharma family, who are so argumentative that they have succeeded in scaring away every cook they've ever employed. So when young chef Raghu shows up, nobody expects him to last long.

title: Aapas Ki Baat
desc: Kajal and Anand are two lovers who are separated when Kajal's family refuses to accept their relationship. Years later, fate brings them face-to-face with each other.
